name: Rubblebelt
description: The Rubblebelt is a ruined region of Ravnica that is home to the Gruul.

description_citations.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
description_citations.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

bio.text: Mazena ordered Ruzi to leave for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.

citations.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citations.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

bio.text: Later, the clanless Arrus noticed the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food all failing and tried to warn Jiri, who refused to listen.

citations.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

status.text: As of the latest event describing it, the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food were failing.

citations.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
timeline.quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi recalls Cecilee's departure for the Rubblebelt and her silence, and that she adopted a Gruul child named for him.
timeline.quote: He'd heard that she'd adopted an abandoned Gruul child to raise as her own.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and Kuma reach the edge of the Rubblebelt before dawn and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.
timeline.quote: Hours later, Ruzi and Kuma had reached the last roof at the edge of the Rubblebelt.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Feeling called to establish a settlement in the Rubblebelt, Cecilee ignores Ruzi's warnings and leads twenty followers there.
timeline.quote: And so she went, leading twenty followers, to the wildest place any of them could imagine.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.
timeline.quote: "They killed your infant!" Ruzi said.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
timeline.quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rejoins Kuma, who guards the baby Zi, and vows to tear down the city.
timeline.quote: "And then we'll tear it down."

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: In the Gruul market, Ossett catches a child thieving but pays the merchant and lets her go.
timeline.quote: I sigh, then let the child go.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ossett enters the bunker and meets her informant Brazer, who insists on playing Clans & Legions first.
timeline.quote: I do," he says, the weariness obvious in his raspy voice. "But first, let's play.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Brazer reveals there is a spy in Boros Legion and demands that the prisoner Baas Solvar be freed from Wargate in exchange for the name.
timeline.quote: There's a spy in the Boros Legion.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Baas Solvar is freed. Ossett waits for Brazer at the market, and Kahti steals her coin purse while hugging her.
timeline.quote: Then I notice my coin purse is gone.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Ossett returns to the bunker and finds Brazer dead with his throat slit and the angel piece of the game missing.
timeline.quote: Only what I find is Brazer's dead body, sitting where I'd left him, slit across his neck.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Arrus gathers ingredients for his magical tattoo ink, tampering with the recipe because the maaka scat is poor.
timeline.quote: so I desperately add more scat to the mix until finally the ink brightens.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: At the ruined battlefront the Ghor Clan builds rubble tributes and Rage spreads through the crowd, but Arrus can only pretend to feel it.
timeline.quote: And just like that, Rage ignites.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus tattoos Jiri and learns Dryzek may challenge Ruric and Thar for chieftain.
timeline.quote: I think he's going to challenge Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain,

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Dryzek tells Arrus that Rage speaks differently to different people, hinting he knows Arrus's heart is cold, and Arrus starts tattooing his arm.
timeline.quote: I know Rage when I see it, and that ain't it. But it'll find you.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Dryzek kneels and offers a roasted drake to Ruric and Thar as a token of loyalty, sealing a blood kinship instead of a coup.
timeline.quote: The deal is sealed with a blood kinship, and all the walls between factions come crashing down.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: The ink Arrus made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, and Ruric and Thar cast Arrus out of the clan.
timeline.quote: Your services are no longer needed here,

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Clanless, Arrus notices the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food are all failing and tries to warn Jiri, who refuses to listen.
timeline.quote: Something's been sucking the life out of the Rubblebelt these last couple months.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus tries to steal the ink of the ogre shaman, who beats him up, and Selesnyan vine magic from spilled ink heals him.
timeline.quote: Slowly, but surely, I feel my broken bones mend.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus follows the ogre to a hydra cave where she steals an egg using a goblin skull lure, and they flee together.
timeline.quote: The ground erupts, spewing rock and stone as a steep ramp forms ahead of us.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus recognizes the ogre as Baas Radley, the shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams.
timeline.quote: Wait. You're Baas Radley. The shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams?

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Baas teaches Arrus to face down a charging battleboar herd and offers to send him to Burning Tree Clan and teach him her ink recipe.
timeline.quote: You're too good to toss to the Wilds.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Baas reveals she was arrested at Tin Street Market and abandoned by Daeska, and why she avoids the front line.
timeline.quote: I got arrested. Daeska got away.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus discovers that trees on the Selesnyan border are only five years old, planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Selesnya had planted thousands and thousands of saplings, and then accelerated their growth until they had the perfect impenetrable barrier.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus challenges Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain and is beaten, repeatedly defying them.
timeline.quote: Ruric pounds his huge fist on the top of my head, and I crumple to the ground

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus finally finds his Rage, rooted in anger at his people's lost stories, and rises from the beating.
timeline.quote: There's no more pain, only Rage.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames.
timeline.quote: He stands behind me, and my flames all but leap for him.

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Ruric and Thar accept Arrus's challenge, set themselves alight and declare war on Selesnya.
timeline.quote: If Selesnya wants a war, we'll give them a war,

citation.text: "Rage of the Unsung" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Domri commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt; Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.
timeline.quote: The cyclops declared Domri an honorary member of the Burning Tree clan.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the clans occupy ruins and expand their territory, disrupting rebuilding and clashing with the Boros.
timeline.quote: Efforts to rebuild Ravnica are constantly and actively disrupted by the Gruul.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal is assigned by Nikya to spy on the Izzet near the Rubblebelt and watches them from a ruined spire.
timeline.quote: Kal was assigned a job by Nikya of the Old Ways to spy on the Izzet

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 10,075 ZC Massacre Girl is hired to destroy a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt and kill its followers, including Cecilee.
timeline.quote: she was hired to destroy a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt and kill its followers

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gruul Zhur-Taa warriors attack Massacre Girl's Rakdos party; Kal's Izzet spell decimates her forces and she retreats from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl herself survived the battle and retreated from the Rubblebelt following this incident.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cecilee establishes a healing outpost in the Rubblebelt and adopts the abandoned Gruul infant Zi.
timeline.quote: taking in an abandoned Gruul infant, naming him Zi

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cecilee refuses to return the child to Nikya's warriors, straining the alliance.
timeline.quote: Cecilee refused, straining the fragile alliance

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Rakdos led by Massacre Girl slaughters Cecilee's followers and kills Cecilee; Zi survives and is rescued by Ruzi.
timeline.quote: Cecilee herself was killed, unaware that her adopted son Zi had survived

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi breaks from the Conclave, turns to the Gruul, and Nikya declares a blood feud against the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Ruzi officially broke from the Conclave and turned to the Gruul

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: which is the location of Skarrg

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
